title: SB0619 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, allows persons employed in emergency management or as firefighters or emergency medical technicians to carry handguns while engaged in the performance of official duties; requires annual completion of a firearm training program. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2019-02-05; crossfiled twin https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/111/Bill/HB0800.pdf is the same printed document (it names SENATE BILL 619); copied from TN-HB-800-2019.draft.txt)
provenance.note: Draft text dated 2019-02-05, shared with twin HB 800; inserts a new (a)(1)(B) and redesignates existing language as (a)(1)(C). Summary says 'As introduced'.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1315(a)(1)(B)): Any person employed in emergency management or as a firefighter or emergency medical technician may carry a handgun while engaged in the performance of the person's official duties pursuant to a written directive by the executive supervisor of the organization to which the person is attached or employed; provided, that the person has successfully completed and continues to successfully complete on an annual basis a firearm training program of at least eight (8) hours duration.
